# ffxf_database_extension (Resource)

Manages the extension feature of an FFXF Cloud database. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_extension" "example" {
  database_id = 42
  name        = "defaultdb"
  extension   = "vector"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Parent database ID.
- `extension` (String) Extension name supported by the database engine.
- `name` (String) Logical database name on which to enable the extension.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this managed database object.
